description.p: Leafport keeps the ebooks you buy or borrow through Adobe-protected stores and libraries in sync. It signs in to your account, downloads every book in your cloud library to a books folder, and keeps that folder up to date. Each book is saved as a plain EPUB or PDF file that any reader opens.

ul.li: Sign in with an Adobe ID or one of the libraries and stores the service offers
Sync one book or the whole cloud library
Open ACSM files from a store or library
